stories.title: SHEIN Recalls ~2,657 Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets Over Choking Hazard

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
SHEIN Baby Rattle & Teether Sets recalled: ~2,657 sets, choking hazard for under-3s. Knobs detach. Sold on SHEIN.com ~$10. Stop use, call 833-853-8668 for a full refund.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Holiday shopping with an infant or toddler at home? Before buying baby and toddler toys this season, check CPSC.gov. The SHEIN rattle recall is a reminder: even budget toys land on the recall list.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: CHE-US Recalls 101,000+ Magnetic Robot Toy Sets Over Magnet Ingestion Risk

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
CPSC recall #27-096: 101,000+ CHE-US magnetic robot toys recalled. High-powered magnets — swallowing two can require emergency surgery. Sold on Amazon at $9–$18. Stop use, contact CHE-US for a refund.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Two magnetic toy CPSC actions in one week. FZChenrry fidget balls Wednesday, CHE-US robot sets today. If you've bought magnetic toy sets from Amazon in the past 18 months, it's worth a check at CPSC.gov.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: D11 Reviews 11 Underused Campuses — District Says No Closures, Just Co-Location

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
D11 board Nov 18: 11 campuses flagged as underused by state criteria. No closures planned — co-location is the strategy. Elementary schools at 81% capacity now, projected to drop to 73% in 10 years.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: New Research: More Screen Time in Childhood Linked to Better Cognitive Processing in Teens

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
New Finnish study: more screen time in childhood linked to faster cognitive processing in teens. But there's a catch — faster responses, lower accuracy. And content type matters more than hours.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
